title: Per-engine lint mappings
description: How each engine implements a repository policy. This file is a translation table and nothing else: it may not restate intent, applicability, blocking posture, semantic options, or fixture meaning, because a second copy of those would be a second policy authority that an engine change could silently move.

engines.description: The engines this table translates for. Version pins are NOT here: they belong to the workspace catalog, which is the single version authority.

policy.description: The stable policy id this row implements. Exactly one; an orphan or a duplicate is refused.

mechanism.description: How the engine realises the policy.

ruleId.description: The vendor rule identity. Bootstrap provenance and engine detail, never policy identity.

engineOptions.description: Verbatim options this engine needs to realise the policy. Not semantics: the repository's meaning is in policy.json.

unavailableReason.description: Required when mechanism is 'unavailable'. Records why the engine cannot express the policy, which keeps the legacy engine rather than dropping the policy.
